_comment: Automated checks for the ACTIVE_OBJECTIVE.md. Paths use ${OPENHARNESS_ROOT} (workspace root) and ${BOOKIE_ROOT} (Bookie repo root, derived from the employee registry) so the same file works on laptop and VPS. After every commit and before declaring any work done, run `harness goal verify`. If anything is red, the immediate next action is to make it green.

criteria.description: OpenHarness memory module exists
OpenHarness reflection module exists
OpenHarness cron module exists
OpenHarness hooks module exists
OpenHarness skills dispatch module exists
OpenHarness goal verification module exists
Bookie tick uses openharness.memory (not just memory_appends)
Bookie tick invokes openharness.skills.run dispatch
Bookie has the self-improvement pattern detector for Bank Rule candidates
Bookie tick has no Plaid references (stripped requirement)
Bookie plaid_feed.py was deleted (stripped requirement)
Bookie anomaly.py was deleted (stripped invented scope)
Bookie close.py was deleted (stripped invented scope)
Bookie browser-automation surface scaffolded
Bookie's FULL test suite passes (test every feature)
Every Bookie feature module (logic-bearing) has a tests/test_<module>.py
criteria.command: cd ${BOOKIE_ROOT} && for m in categorizer coa reports qbo browser; do test -f tests/test_$m.py || { echo "missing test_$m.py"; exit 1; }; done

criteria.description: OpenHarness workspace integrity check passes
Bookie is registered as an employee in OpenHarness
Bookie's categorize-transaction skill is in the discoverable skills dir
Bookie requirements.md exists (traceable scope)
Weekly reflection cron job is registered for Bookie
Claude Code hooks settings.json installed (laptop only)
SessionStart hook script exists (laptop only)
UserPromptSubmit hook script exists (laptop only)
PostToolUse Bash hook for git commit exists (laptop only)
Stop hook script exists (laptop only)
harness preamble subcommand is defined (the context injected by hooks)
OpenHarness working tree has no uncommitted tracked changes
OpenHarness laptop HEAD matches origin/master
criteria.command: cd ${OPENHARNESS_ROOT} && git fetch -q origin && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/master)"

criteria.description: Bookie working tree has no uncommitted tracked changes
Bookie laptop HEAD matches origin/master
criteria.command: cd ${BOOKIE_ROOT} && git fetch -q origin && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/master)"

criteria.description: state/chat.db is gitignored (was causing chronic VPS-laptop merge conflicts)
state/last-tick-cursor.json is gitignored
No claude-owned, unblocked, incomplete setup step is left undone (catches Claude assigning his own work to John)
The emailed setup checklist reflects the current SETUP.md (catches stale derived artifacts)
Bookie setup-plan.json (single source of truth for setup steps) exists
The continuous-work-loop doctrine is encoded in Chief of Staff SOUL.md (loads every session)
